source_plan.rule: The source plan remains immutable. This v2.1 document is the self-contained approved successor for diagnostic-v1.

current_evidence_boundary.phase_c: operational_diagnostic_profile_qualified on its own qualification contract
current_evidence_boundary.phase_d: one controlled automatic write-to-query closure on the production contract

benchmark_identity.name: KE-memory diagnostic benchmark v1
purpose: Build, inspect and expand a frozen foundational ontology that covers common memory situations.
Measure natural-expression to canonical-ontology mapping without letting the mapper leak benchmark answers.
Expose extraction, abstraction, retrieval, execution and answer failures on natural memory benchmarks.
Determine whether failures belong to implementation, ontology coverage or architecture, and attribute them to the correct module.

ontology_model.ontology: A versioned namespace of stable ids, senses, aliases, types, relations, roles and constraints. A bare string vocabulary is insufficient because mapping correctness requires identity and sense.
ontology_model.KEOL: A method for dynamic ontology construction: unmapped expressions become candidates that can be normalized, deduplicated, conflict-checked, admitted or rejected, and versioned. In diagnostic-v1 it is observed only as a side track and is not a core scored capability.
ontology_model.Extended_AMR: An extension of AMR's ontology space and an instance-graph encoding bound to canonical ontology items. It is a possible carrier, not the preselected carrier and not a competitor to KEOL.

foundation_layout.memory_core: Shared cross-scenario concepts for provenance, identity, time, modality, polarity, conflict, supersession, evidence and lifecycle.
foundation_layout.domain_namespaces: Versioned domain/* namespaces for scenario-specific concepts; dataset/* namespaces are forbidden as containers for answer-specific benchmark concepts.
foundation_layout.O_L1: Atomic event, state, preference, task and attribute ontology. Frozen and hashed independently.
foundation_layout.O_L2: Cross-turn and cross-session abstraction ontology. Frozen and hashed independently from O_L1.
foundation_layout.cross_layer_map: Explicit versioned derivation/import map. Shared vocabulary is never implicit.

ontology_foundation_pilot.language: English only for diagnostic-v1; canonical ids are language-neutral and aliases carry language tags.

target_scale.coverage_spans: approximately 500 spans for automatic candidate mining and coverage analysis

mandatory_second_review: suspected false merge or false split

data_separation.ontology_build_corpus: Used only to build and inspect the ontology foundation.
data_separation.ontology_mapping_gold: Separately authored cases used to score mapping quality; not used to derive aliases, prompts or ontology items after freeze.
data_separation.end_to_end_benchmarks: Native BEAM, LoCoMo and LongMemEval inputs used for the diagnostic memory run.
data_separation.legacy_32_item_slice: Dev and regression only; permanently forbidden as fresh hidden.
no_cross_contamination: No benchmark question, answer, gold evidence id or rubric enters ontology construction.
No formal mapping-gold failure may add an alias or ontology item before that frozen evaluation is reported.
No end-to-end failure may change the prompt, ontology, mapper or executor and then be rerun on the same formal set.

freeze_order: Load the frozen ontology and public conversation only.
Map L1 and L2 to the complete frozen ontology without benchmark-derived candidate retrieval.
Freeze extraction, mapping, L1/L2 memory and provenance.
Only after memory freeze reveal the benchmark questions to query compilation.
mapper_anti_cheating_contract.query_mapper: Separate from the memory mapper but bound to the same complete frozen ontology and version hashes.
mapper_anti_cheating_contract.unsupported_query_rule: An unsupported query must be reported as executor capability failure. The task contract may not exclude it after inspection.
forbidden_shortcuts: candidate retrieval that uses question or sample identity
reading gold evidence before memory freeze

forbidden: heuristic keyword or regular-expression semantic correction
semantic gates that correct model output or force abstention
contract narrowing that removes unsupported natural questions
targeted prompt or ontology optimization against formal failures
rerunning the same formal set after a semantic repair
semantic_assistance_policy.invalid_structure_rule: Invalid structure is scored as an error; integrity checks do not repair semantics.
semantic_assistance_policy.reporting_rule: Raw model and mapper quality is reported directly. A structural rejection is not evidence that the model understood the case.

L1.unit: A user message, agent message, tool message or tool event; surrounding context may resolve reference but may not supply an unstated fact.
L1.revision: Append-only. Later information confirms, corrects, supersedes or conflicts with prior revisions instead of overwriting them.

L2.input: Frozen L1 units, their raw evidence and only the necessary prior context.
requirements: typed abstraction independent of O_L1 vocabulary
no benchmark question, future session or gold access
L2.reporting: Raw abstraction, ontology mapping, derivation and evidence closure are scored separately.

memory_construction_contract.answer_model_boundary: For the ontology arm, the answer model may read only the question, query plan, symbolic matches and selected EvidenceSpans. It may not read the full conversation history.

official_arms.purpose: Measure answer capability when no memory compression or ontology mapping is required.

official_arms.input: raw evidence units under the same question and answer budget
one query-blind frozen memory build plus symbolic query execution
official_arms.purpose: Measure the current architecture and ontology mapping path.

external_system_boundary: Mem0, Graphiti, Hindsight, MemPalace, Zep and similar systems are not rerun in diagnostic-v1. Author-reported results remain external context only.

diagnostic_benchmark_sample.selection: Pre-registered natural-question sampling before any system output is inspected.
special_annotations: LongMemEval oracle-haystack conditions are reported separately and never generalized to full retrieval.
LoCoMo category 5 remains manual_required where official answer gold is insufficient.

architecture_diagnostics.carrier_rule: No new Extended-AMR or KEOL projection experiment and no carrier selection in diagnostic-v1. Existing native-carrier round-trip is an offline diagnostic only.

module_ownership.extraction: surface events, states, roles, source status, time, modality, polarity and evidence spans
module_ownership.ontology: canonical ids, senses, aliases, types, relations, constraints, O_L1/O_L2 and cross-layer map
module_ownership.mapping: surface-semantic to canonical ontology decision and ambiguity or unresolved state
module_ownership.identity: entity identity, merge, split, membership and reference resolution
module_ownership.history: immutable revisions, conflict, supersession and temporal state
module_ownership.L2: cross-turn and cross-session abstraction, derivation and closure
module_ownership.query: question mapping, QuerySlotPlan and unsupported-operation reporting
module_ownership.executor: symbolic constraints, joins, counts, time, negation, conflict and abstention
module_ownership.retrieval: candidate evidence recovery without semantic authority
module_ownership.storage_snapshot: atomic write, replay, revision binding and byte recovery
module_ownership.pipeline: ordering, isolation and end-to-end state transitions

L1_L2_structure: L1 source, time, modality, polarity and lifecycle accuracy
retrieval_execution_answer: latency, tokens and cost when available
no_compensation: L2 may not hide an L1 failure.
Final answer correctness may not hide wrong evidence.
A structural validator intervention may not hide raw semantic error.

model_protocol.stability_check: Pre-register repeated inference on 10 percent of the sample and report disagreement; repetition is for stability measurement, not majority-vote repair.
model_protocol.retry: Only a transport failure may resend the byte-identical request. A semantic or schema failure is a scored failure and is not retried.

failure_attribution.architecture_change_candidate_rule: Only oracle_confirmed evidence, or a reproduced failure that is also cross_source, may enter a later architecture-change discussion.
method: Freeze the untouched failure and all relevant intermediate artifacts.
Locate the earliest incorrect module output.
Use the smallest pre-registered oracle substitution that can falsify the attribution.
Compare downstream change without modifying the formal run.
Assign one primary owner and record secondary propagation separately.
Do not repair, tune or rerun during diagnostic-v1.

execution_stages.name: preflight and freeze
outputs: model, prompt, ontology, mapper, executor and scorer identities
root-test skipped test id and reason

execution_stages.name: ontology foundation pilot
execution_stages.rule: Freeze before end-to-end benchmark questions are exposed to the memory mapper.

execution_stages.name: harness and anti-cheating regression
outputs: no semantic heuristic or gate audit
execution_stages.rule: This stage validates instrumentation only and produces no benchmark claim.

execution_stages.name: untouched diagnostic-v1 run
outputs: all intermediate L1, mapping, L2, query, evidence and answer artifacts
execution_stages.rule: One formal run under frozen inputs. No semantic repair or targeted rerun.

execution_stages.name: RCA and architecture diagnosis
outputs: architecture issue ledger with evidence levels
execution_stages.rule: Report findings only. Do not implement repairs.

mandatory_stop.trigger: The diagnostic-v1 RCA report and its immutable evidence index are complete.
actions: do not add ontology entries or aliases from formal failures
do not tune prompts, mapper, executor or answer model
do not rerun the formal sample
do not start a larger benchmark
do not rerun external memory systems
do not make benchmark-ready or production-ready claims
mandatory_stop.next_step: Return the RCA report to the user and wait for a separate decision about ontology expansion, module repairs, architecture changes and the design of a fresh evaluation.
